_comment: Form 13F-HR institutional-manager universe (NOT issuer CIKs — these file quarterly holdings reports about OTHER companies, unlike config/ciks_full.json). Every CIK below was verified live against data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{cik}.json to confirm it is the correct entity name and has a recent (2026) 13F-HR filing, not a stale/inactive registration or a '13F-NT' notice-only sub-entity that reports combined elsewhere. See docs/PIPELINE.md for the lookup method (EDGAR full-text search, https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index) used when a manager's obvious holding-company CIK turned out to be notice-only.
